_comment: Advisory trigger evals for generating-audio — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. One case per trigger surface, plus cross-skill negatives and out-of-scope audio negatives (music / SFX / dubbing are NOT this skill and must not trigger it).

cases.query: create a voiceover for our product video
read this script aloud in a warm, friendly voice
turn this text to speech for the ad
narrate our brand story in an upbeat tone
I need spoken audio of this announcement
do an ad read of this promo copy
generate a voice for the character in this scene

cases._note: Mixed brief: the speech part IS in scope so the skill must trigger, then decline the music and the mixing. The likeliest production failure — an agent that silently works around the gap.
cases.query: I need a voiceover reading our tagline plus a chill background track under it
generate an image of a brand logo
make a video of a sunset over the ocean
write us a short upbeat theme tune to open the podcast
I need a door slam and some busy cafe background for this scene
take this finished cut and put it into German keeping the same speaker
